title: 蕾欧娜·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 赤褐头发与金色太阳额饰相映，宽阔金甲勾勒厚重轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Leona is an adult Solari knight with long auburn hair, a gold sun-shaped forehead ornament, warm focused eyes, and broad golden armor plates. Preserve her athletic natural adult silhouette with fully armored torso, covered legs, gauntlets, and boots, accented by red cloth. Her straight sword remains sheathed and the large ornate sun shield is grounded beside her, never raised against a target.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sun gold, auburn, ivory stone, cobalt shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
